apache/apisix.description: Apache APISIX uses NGINX and etcd with dynamic routing and plugin loading. Publisher documentation covers API traffic management and AI proxy plugins for provider routing, retries and token-based rate limits.

kgateway-dev/kgateway.description: Kgateway implements the Kubernetes Gateway API as an Envoy control plane. Its publisher says the agentgateway control plane moved to the separate agentgateway repository starting with version 2.3.0.
